pages.raw_meta: Discover how PPG’s global team of innovators drives sustainable solutions, enhances productivity, and celebrates 140 years of color leadership. Join us!
raw_blocks: PPG: We protect and beautify the world®
The first-choice partner to meet customers’ evolving needs for innovative paints, coatings and surface solutions.
$15.8 billion net sales from operations
In business for more than 140 years

Our global teams work every day to develop and deliver the paints, coatings and specialty products that our customers have trusted for more than 140 years. Explore our businesses and the markets they serve.
We've got you covered with industry-leading transparencies, coatings, sealants, engineered materials and services designed to maximize aircraft performance across the entire lifecycle.

Delivering the right solution for every surface to create longer-lasting, more beautiful spaces through a global portfolio of leading paint and stain brands – driven by sustainable innovation, color expertise and modern digital tools.
Combining our expertise in coatings and technologies to aid automakers around the world in enhancing the image and identity of their vehicle brands.
When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, Our refinish business owns a track record of success no other company can match.
Leading industrial manufacturers of the best-known products, landmarks and brands trust us to deliver the innovations and services that enhance and protect assets used every day.

Our extensive range of metal packaging coatings are designed protect the quality of our favorite consumer goods from both inside and outside the can including food, beverages and personal care products.
We’re developing coatings that help protect assets across industries, including infrastructure, oil and gas, power, renewables and marine vessels, in the world's most demanding environments.

Partnering with customers to solve complex challenges, our advanced materials transform industries –enhancing vision and eye safety, safeguarding critical documents, enabling water reuse, and powering next-generation, energy-efficient OLED displays – improving everyday life worldwide.

The broad portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint, thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

pages.raw_meta: From pre-treatment to colorful topcoats, PPG Industrial Coatings delivers high-performance products across a range of technologies for a variety of industries.
raw_blocks: Our coatings are just the start. Choose PPG and you select one of the world’s most trusted brand of industrial coatings. But far more important, you enlist a partner in success – creating efficiencies that save you time and money providing products that satisfy your customers. That’s the Power of a Partner.
The real plus is the total solution you get from a reliable partner.

We invite you to explore PPG and learn why our commitment to your success goes beyond paints and coatings. Whether you are satisfied with your current coatings supplier or exploring new options, we encourage you to give us a try. We’re ready to earn your trust and demonstrate the difference that PPG’s Power of a Partnership can make in your business.
